o: Face a difficult situation with courage
free.e: This idiom means to bravely accept something unpleasant or difficult.

free.q: The process by which green plants make their own food using sunlight is called:
free.e: Photosynthesis is the process plants use to convert sunlight into food energy.

free.q: "To let the cat out of the bag" means to:
free.e: This idiom means to accidentally reveal a secret.

free.q: Identify the figure of speech: "The wind whispered secrets through the trees."
free.e: Giving the wind the human ability to whisper is personification.
